learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose 6 times faster against8 and4; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Ran double A only, double B only and double both sequentially. Table grew from one baseline to four runs. Actual screenshot showed baseline×1, A-only×2, B-only×4 and both×8 with proportional bars.
observations.reveal: Corrected to8, explained effects multiply2×4 rather than add. Introduced rate=k[A][B]² and said exponents come from experiment rather than reaction equation.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshots inspected. Four pink bars carry1,2,4,8 relation; concentration labels and all reveal legible. AX exposes run count/buttons but not table values, so values directly observed in screenshot.

interaction.reason: Single-factor and combined runs expose product relation.

payoff.reason: Directly connects all three observed rates to multiplicative rate law.

clarity.reason: Labeled table and bars clearly show tested desktop contrast.

transfer.reason: Reusable empirical rate-law relation but no concrete new application or fresh case.

accessibility.reason: No access audit; table values absent from tested AX output.
accessibility.evidence: Values required visual screenshot; keyboard,focus,contrast,phone,zoom and motion unknown.

visualExplanation.reason: Bar lengths show product rather than sum.
visualExplanation.evidence: Four proportional bars in actual screenshot.

playfulness.reason: Three experiment choices permit controlled comparison.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete rate prediction for a stated reaction model.

depth.reason: Factor combination and experimental order inference linked.

complexity.reason: Combines two measured multiplicative factors; symbolic law adds representation burden.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Core is two-factor multiplication; optional symbolic description introduces rate law.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low for sighted desktop path; AX table values not exposed in observed tree.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: moderate: reaction rate and empirical order.

whyCool: Running both changes makes an eightfold bar after the individual twofold and fourfold bars.
caveat: Only one fixed rate law; clear-table reset and new concentration factors not tested.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
